idea-plugin.name: Claude Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Agentic coding with your own Claude account, inside JetBrains IDEs — no JetBrains AI credits and no separate API key.

This plugin drives the locally-installed Claude Code CLI (which you log in to with your Claude subscription) and renders the conversation, tool activity, and file edits in a tool window. Claude works directly in your open project — reading and editing source like Claude Code in the terminal, but with an IDE-native chat, diff, and permission UI.

Requires the claude CLI installed and logged in. Independent, unofficial project; not affiliated with Anthropic or JetBrains.
